summary: ProvinceTooltip_Build read whole: head, frame, terrain, political and supply parts, tail, and the flag icon in text.

addresses.name: ProvinceTooltip_Build
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __stdcall ProvinceTooltip_Build(void* provinceBase@ECX, GuiTooltipText* out@stack:4, CMapProvince* province@stack:8) @EAX
addresses.comment: Builds the tooltip for the province under the mouse (0x2244 byte frame, reached through a vtable); switches once on the map mode. **Read whole 2026-10-11.** `this` is the province's second base (8 in), the stack holds the out GuiTooltipText and the province itself; a null province gives an empty tooltip. Then: a selected army's UTM_* line (one at most, "\n"+text+"\n"); the name (slot 7); " (" + the owner's name + ")" where the owner's id is not 0; a debug block when g_TooltipDebug is set; the whole tooltip emptied where the template's `simulated` (+0x13D) is clear; the mode's part; the tail - a selected air unit's or fleet's distance from its base and its range in km, the objectives (OL_AO_*), and PROV_DISTANCE_FROM for a selected other province. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provincetooltip.md, section 1 to 3, 7.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; `ret 8`; the null test at 0x497406..; the selection kinds read off their slot 1 bodies.
addresses.revises: Signature added and the head, frame and tail described.

addresses.name: ProvinceTooltip_Mode0_13
addresses.comment: Tooltip builder branch for map mode 0 and 13: terrain lines. On land the flags - " - ( @" + owner + ")" where owner and controller are one and not id 0, else " - ( @" + controller + "/@" + owner + ")", the controller first - then for any province "\n" + the terrain's name and "\n" + its figures (CTerrain_BuildFigures). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provincetooltip.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x498824..0x498891 for the order of the flags.

addresses.name: ProvinceTooltip_Mode1
addresses.comment: Tooltip builder branch for map mode 1: political lines. On land only: the same flags as the terrain mode, then "\n" + the terrain's name. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provincetooltip.md, section 5.

addresses.name: ProvinceTooltip_Mode4
addresses.comment:
Tooltip builder branch for map mode 4: supply (LOGTT_*, PORT_SHIPS) lines. At sea, the player's convoys: "
"+LOGTT_8+start+LOGTT_9+end+LOGTT_10 and a "
   "+CONV_SHIP_IRO per good carried. On land under 0.200 MaxInfrastructure, "
"+TOOLOWINFRA. Else, with the player's intel above 5: the infrastructure line (SUPPLY_INFRA_EFFECT_INFO, or SUPPLY_INFRA_CAPITAL_EFFECT_INFO in a capital) between newlines, then LOGTT_1 with the depot in §Y and " ("+distance+" "+LOGTT_2+")"; above 8: LOGTT_3/4, 5/6, 7/6 with their colours, and PORT_SHIPS with a naval base. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provincetooltip.md, section 6.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; the convoy line's order off listing 0x49AA92..0x49AC9A.

addresses.name: CountryNameOfTag

addresses.name: CEU3BitmapFont::DrawFlagIcon
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CEU3BitmapFont::DrawFlagIcon(CEU3BitmapFont* this, char* tag, int x, int y)
addresses.comment: Slot 21: what `@TAG` in a text draws. The tag's country id (0 taken as 1) picks a cell of a flag atlas, drawn as a quad 23 by 11 from 3 to 14 below the line's top `y`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provincetooltip.md, section 8.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; `ret 0xC`; 23.0 and 11.0 at 0x160AA28/0x160AA30; DrawText calls it at 0xAFCE58.

addresses.name: CEU3BitmapFont::FlagIconWidth
addresses.comment: Slot 26: 24, what the pen moves on by after `@TAG`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provincetooltip.md, section 8.

addresses.name: GuiTooltipText::Clear
addresses.comment: Empties the three strings and sets position 0, below true. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provincetooltip.md, section 3.

addresses.name: g_TooltipDebug
addresses.no_signature: A global byte, not a function.
addresses.comment: Flipped by a console command that says 'Tooltip debug ENABLED' (0x4436EF). Set, ProvinceTooltip_Build adds the country's tag and id and the province's id, and shows a province that is not simulated. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provincetooltip.md, section 3.

struct_fields.name: carried_by
struct_fields.comment: The fleet carrying the army, or null. Cleared by CNavy::UnloadCarried (0x5CFEA1) and RemoveFromTransport (0x5CF193); ProvinceTooltip_Build gives UTM_LACK_OF_SUPPLIES only where it is null. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provincetooltip.md, section 2.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x497A64 tests [army+0x300] after slot 9, which answers the army itself.

struct_fields.name: name
struct_fields.comment: The province's name, what CProvince::GetName answers. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provincetooltip.md, section 3.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x4A9D40 copies +0xB0 of the template into its out string.
